rationale: No existing spec references connect-data-source-popup or community-slack-invite selectors (grep returned nothing). edition-features.spec.js and status-pages-enterprise-gating.spec.js are the closest gating idioms to mirror, but they cover different features (the enterprise upsell dialog and the status-pages dropdown gate), not this onboarding popup. The feature is a brand-new, cross-cutting MainLayout popup with its own area folder (GeneralTests) and its own run-context spec_path, so a new spec + ci_matrix registration is correct.
